PROGRAM heater_ctrl
VAR_INPUT
    HeatRequest : BOOL;
    Enable      : BOOL;
    OverTemp    : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT
    Heater      : BOOL;
END_VAR
VAR
    (* No internal variables needed for this logic *)
END_VAR

(*
    Heater is energized when there is a heat demand (HeatRequest)
    and the system is enabled (Enable).
    An over-temperature sensor (OverTemp = TRUE when too hot) must
    unconditionally cut the heater off as a safety override.
    The heater is not latching: it follows demand each scan when safe.
*)
Heater := HeatRequest AND Enable AND NOT OverTemp;

END_PROGRAM
